label: Village of North Bennington
header:
# Village of North Bennington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 251 (Village of North Bennington): section 203(a) provides for trustees elected at the annual meeting to make a full board of five trustees; section 301 staggers trustee terms at three years
Village of North Bennington, Board of Trustees minutes, January 13, 2026: seat Trustees Rogers, Creedy, and Mullineaux in person and Trustees Patterson and Lowary via Zoom

Village of North Bennington, Board of Trustees special (reorganization) meeting minutes, March 19, 2026: record the oaths administered after the March 17, 2026 annual meeting: Tara Lowary re-elected trustee (three-year term) and David Shaughnessey newly elected trustee (three-year term), and Mary Rogers nominated Chair. Matthew Patterson, seated in January, departed at the annual meeting and is not recorded. The June 9, 2026 minutes print the surname 'Shaughnessy'; the oath minutes' spelling governs
Village of North Bennington, Board of Trustees minutes, June 9, 2026: seat Trustees Rogers, Shaughnessey, Creedy, Lowary, and Mullineaux in person, with Rogers as Chair
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 251 (Village of North Bennington): section 203(a) provides for a Clerk elected at every annual meeting

Village of North Bennington, Board of Trustees special (reorganization) meeting minutes, March 19, 2026: record the oath administered to re-elected Village Clerk Lorine Elwell (the form of her name in the oath line and her signature; the minutes' running text uses Lori Elwell, the name recorded here)

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 251 (Village of North Bennington): section 203(a) provides for a Treasurer elected at every annual meeting; section 305 makes the Treasurer also perform the duties of a collector of town taxes, so no separate collector post is created although the village's older annual meetings elected a Collector of Taxes as a separate article
Village of North Bennington, Board of Trustees special (reorganization) meeting minutes, March 19, 2026: record the oath administered to re-elected Treasurer Doug Buggee

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 251 (Village of North Bennington): section 203(a) provides for a Moderator elected at every annual meeting; the March 2026 outcome is published in no official source located, so the post is created without a membership. John Ulrich, elected moderator at the annual meeting recorded in the village's 2024 annual report, is held as a straggler

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 251 (Village of North Bennington): section 203(a) provides for three auditors elected at every annual meeting; the annual meeting recorded in the village's 2024 annual report left all three auditor seats vacant (no nominations) and the March 2026 outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without memberships
